data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 3.3m (2016: GBP 1.5m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 17.563m and experienced a favourable prior accident year run-off (a release) of GBP 3.3m during 2017 (approximately an 18.8% release relative to opening gross claims). The movement is described as a prior accident year release driven by favourable claims development; no specific named events or years are cited as drivers in the disclosed commentary.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 3.3m (2016: GBP 1.5m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement sourced from Note 5 narrative which states a GBP 3.3m favourable run-off deviation. The note does not explicitly state whether this figure is gross or net of reinsurance; the report does not present a separate explicit gross figure labelled 'prior year movement' elsewhere. Therefore the GBP 3.3m has been recorded as the prior year movement but may be net of reinsurance. The syndicate is a long-term term-life writer and LOB mapping to 'Accident & Health' is an inference (life business not explicitly in the standard Lloyd's LOB list). A gross claims development triangle is available and has been included in _claims_triangle for cross-checking.
